title: Flood Risk Mapping and the Distributional Impacts of Climate Information
title_zh: 洪水风险图绘制与气候信息的分配效应
authors: Weill, Joakim A.
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the provision of official flood risk information in the United States and its distributional impacts on residential flood insurance take-up. Assembling all flood maps produced after Hurricane Katrina, I document that updated maps decreased the number of properties zoned in high-risk floodplains and incorrectly omitted five million properties, primarily in neighborhoods with more Black and Hispanic residents. Leveraging the staggered timing of map updates, I estimate that updated maps decreased flood insurance take-up and exacerbated racial disparities in insurance coverage. While past map updates distorted risk and price signals, correcting flood maps would yield substantial welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国官方洪水风险信息的提供及其对住宅洪水保险参保率的分配效应。通过整合卡特里娜飓风后发布的所有洪水地图，我发现更新后的地图减少了划入高风险洪泛区的房产数量，并错误地遗漏了500万处房产，这些房产主要位于黑人和西班牙裔居民较多的社区。利用地图更新的交错时间安排，我估计更新后的地图降低了洪水保险的参保率，并加剧了保险覆盖中的种族差异。尽管过去的地图更新扭曲了风险与价格信号，但修正洪水地图将带来显著的福利收益。

title: National eco-industrial demonstration parks and green innovation agglomeration: Evidence from China
title_zh: 国家生态工业示范园区与绿色创新集聚：来自中国的证据
authors: Xing Zhao, Changruiqing Liu, Chien-Chiang Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Promoting green innovation agglomeration (GIA) is essential for achieving a sustainable industrial transformation, strengthening resource efficiency and advancing the low-carbon progression. However, the role of eco-industrial demonstration parks (EIDPs) in fostering GIA remains insufficiently explored. Using panel data from 297 prefecture-level cities in China for the period 2000–2022, this study systematically examines the impact of EIDPs on GIA. The empirical results show that (1) EIDPs significantly promote GIA, a conclusion that maintains its validity through robustness and endogeneity checks. (2) Heterogeneity checks indicate that the EIDPs’ effect is more evident among cities possessing high government governance capacity, high environmental preference, and high market spillover level. (3) A mechanism analysis reveals that EIDPs enhance GIA by improving green technology diversity, innovation factors’ allocation efficiency and external media coverage. Such outcomes enrich research on EIDPs and GIA and provide policy insights for optimizing EIDPs’ governance, improving green innovation resource allocation, and accelerating the formation of regionally coordinated green innovation systems.
abstract_zh: 促进绿色创新集聚是实现可持续产业转型、增强资源效率以及推动低碳进程的关键。然而，生态工业示范园区在培育绿色创新集聚方面的作用尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2000—2022年中国297个地级市的面板数据，系统考察了生态工业示范园区对绿色创新集聚的影响。实证结果表明：（1）生态工业示范园区显著促进了绿色创新集聚，该结论在稳健性检验和内生性检验中依然成立；（2）异质性检验显示，生态工业示范园区的效应在政府治理能力高、环境偏好强以及市场溢出水平高的城市中更为显著；（3）机制分析揭示，生态工业示范园区通过提升绿色技术多样性、创新要素配置效率以及外部媒体关注度来增强绿色创新集聚。这些成果丰富了关于生态工业示范园区与绿色创新集聚的研究，并为优化生态工业示范园区治理、改善绿色创新资源配置以及加速形成区域协调的绿色创新体系提供了政策启示。

title: Trade, Voting, and Firm Policies: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 贸易、投票与企业政策：理论与证据
authors: John Duffy, Daniel Friedman, Jean Paul Rabanal, Olga Rud
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以分析股东交易与投票在制定具有外部性的公司政策时的相互作用，其中投资者对这些外部性存在异质性偏好，并通过实验室实验检验了模型的均衡预测。模型表明（且实验结果证实）：低政策成本有利于政策采纳，而在中等成本条件下，分散偏好下的政策采纳率低于极化偏好。当政策被采纳时，观察到的股价高于均衡预测值，且接近未采纳政策时公司的基本面价值。我们得出结论：具有外部性的高成本政策对股东的负担可能低于理论预测。

title: Beta for Alpha: Neural Engagement in Financial Trading
title_zh: 阿尔法的贝塔：金融交易中的神经参与
authors: Liang Chen, Tse-Chun Lin, Fei Wu, Xingjian Zheng, Eric Zou
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings. We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading. Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution. Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance. We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.
abstract_zh: 可穿戴脑电图（EEG）技术的出现，为在实时且具有重大财务后果的环境中识别和量化决策的神经关联提供了新机遇。我们报告了一项实地研究，利用可穿戴EEG设备记录专业日内交易员在真实高风险交易中的脑电波活动。基于这些信号，我们构建了已确立的心理生理学参与指数（Engagement Index, EI），该指数定义为β波功率除以α波与θ波功率之和，并观察到交易执行前后明显的尖峰-衰减模式。将EI动态与交易绩效关联后，我们发现更成功的交易在执行前30秒内伴随更大的EI尖峰，而基线或背景EI水平则无预测能力，甚至与绩效呈负相关。进一步研究表明，较高的EI与交易中行为偏差的减弱相关，包括整数启发式偏差和处置效应。

title: Empathy, Social Networks, and Academic Achievement: Experimental Evidence on Cross-Productivity in Skill Formation
title_zh: 共情、社交网络与学业成就：技能形成中交叉生产率的实验证据
authors: Flavio Cunha, Qinyou Hu, Yiming Xia, Naibao Zhao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We evaluate a parent-directed empathy development program for middle school students in China using a randomized trial with 2,246 students. The four-month mobile app intervention produced short-run gains in empathy and reduced bullying but no immediate academic effects. Over the longer term, treatment students were 3.2 percentage points more likely to enter elite high schools and 2.5 percentage points less likely to miss the entrance exam. We trace these gains to improved self-beliefs and a restructuring of classroom friendship networks that reduced academic homophily, revealing a social channel of cross-productivity: non-cognitive investments can reshape peer relationships to improve academic outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项包含2,246名学生的随机试验，评估了一项针对中国中学生、由家长指导的共情发展项目。为期四个月的移动应用干预在短期内提升了学生的共情能力并减少了欺凌行为，但未对学业成绩产生即时影响。从长期来看，实验组学生进入重点高中的概率提高了3.2个百分点，而错过升学考试的概率降低了2.5个百分点。我们将这些成效归因于学生自我信念的改善以及课堂友谊网络的重构——后者降低了学业同质性，揭示了一种跨领域生产力的社会传导机制：非认知能力投资能够重塑同伴关系，进而提升学业表现。

title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期
authors: Gorkem Bostanci, Guillermo Ordoñez
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.

abstract: Abstract We show that carbon pricing and bank credit complement each other in reducing firms' carbon emission intensity. Our identification exploits a reform‐driven carbon price increase in the EU emission trading system (ETS) and administrative microdata, including the Italian credit registry. We find that highly exposed ETS firms increase term‐loan demand, relative to less exposed ETS firms. Such credit channel is associated with larger investment, but not with higher carbon emissions, reducing emission intensity. These effects are significant only among firms undertaking green investments. Moreover, higher credit demand by ETS firms crowds out credit supply to smaller firms in brown sectors.
